messages:
zara: repro'd a weird perf drop on 8k seq when fused RoPE runs with the hybrid Flash/paged kernel. ~20% throughput down after the kernel selector refactor.
leo: can you share repro steps and exact flags?
zara: small harness — run: ```./bench --model gpt-small --seq 8192 --batch 2 --kernel hybrid --rotary-scale=1.0```
anika: saw similar on my run. KV cache seems to evict earlier, + extra memcpy per step when rotary dims != head_dim. :eyes:
benchmark-bot: 1765432110: perf run finished — throughput: 330 tok/s (baseline ~420 tok/s), p95 220ms, gpu_util 72%
leo: paste profiler counters? nvprof / nsight snippets help.
zara: copied a short excerpt:
```
SharedMemoryStall: 12.3%
MemoryThruput: 58 GB/s
L2ReadHitRate: 86%
DeviceMemReadBytes: 1.2 GB
ExtraMemcpyOps: 8 per step (rotary stride mismatch)
```
anika: hypothesis: kernel selector treats "rotary_scaled" models as incompatible with fused flash path for seq>4096, so it picks paged-hybrid which has worse scheduling with our batch sizes. Also rotary implementation adds an elementwise reshape+mul which causes an extra memcpy for non-contiguous heads.
zara: quick experiment: force `--kernel flash_fused` -> throughput 412 tok/s (close to baseline).
leo: that points to selector logic bug. maybe the compatibility check is too conservative for scaled-rotary variants.
anika: also noticed when rotary dims are scaled (rotary_scale != 1.0) the per-head stride differs and our KV cache hot-path falls back to a slow memcpy path.
zara: opening issue with logs & micro-repro: https://redwood/kernels/issue/1234 — attached bench output and nvprof.
leo: assigning to me. I'll add a unit test for rotary-dim != head_dim, a microbench to exercise page vs fused, and a fix to selector heuristics.
dev-relia: noted — assigned @leo, please tag QA and add perf test to CI.
zara: thanks — I'll run a sweep across batch sizes [1,2,4,8] and seq lengths [2048,4096,8192] and attach traces.
benchmark-bot: 1765432154 deploy-bench: canary completed, regression confirmed on hybrid selector.
leo: I'll push a prototype guard to prefer flash_fused when rotary_scale is enabled unless memory pressure high. Will post results.
anika: FYI, also check transformer config flag `rotary_dim_fraction` — edge cases when rotary dims not multiple of head dim cause packing to misalign.
zara: ok thanks — will re-run after your patch. :thumbsup:
